description: Building detailed programs and projects in scheduling tools that the team does not all use can make it hard to keep tasks, milestone dates, and ongoing changes available in real time. Tools such as Oracle Primavera P6 Enterprise Project Portfolio Management or Microsoft Project are not typically deployed to the whole project team, so the project team may be working with out-of-date information, putting key milestones and tasks at risk. Microsoft Power BI is a powerful tool commonly used for project data visualization and project team dashboarding. Gantt charts are an ideal way to understand the flow of activities, but the current offerings of Gantt charts for Power BI lack many of the features you need to communicate your scheduling data. Emerald BI-GanttView, designed specifically for teams using Oracle Primavera P6 Enterprise Project Portfolio Management, provides a cleaner, smoother Power BI experience, offering the features you need to create clear and effective Gantt charts. Enjoy Gantt charts with increased functionality and better usability, making it easier than ever to see important deliverables, responsibilities, deadlines, and progress in your schedule, all in a robust dashboard. What’s more, with Emerald BI-GanttView, powerful and flexible stylings make Gantt charts easier to configure and develop into user-friendly charts that your team will use. With configurable…
